descriptions.d17b_land_sphere_query_800bdb5c: Clear the shared land query result through its value update, fill the self mask with the land groups touched by the sphere, then walk the registered land groups with a running mask bit and return 1 at the first selected group whose sphere intersection test succeeds (the position is passed by value), otherwise 0. Partial observed layouts; no owned initialized data. Compiled with the original paired-single float switch -mps-float (reserves the FPR pair frame slot).
